findings.method: SQL aggregation with GROUP BY month
findings.code:
SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(date AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR) as month,
    SUM(revenue) as total_revenue
FROM monthly_revenue
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(date AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR) IN ('2025-03', '2025-04')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
